notes.title: Discord Server & Content Update!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!
It’s been a while—we hope your 2025 is off to a great start! We’re excited to share some big news with you! 🎉  
First, we are opening our 🐰BunBun Games Discord🐰 to the public! Connect with our community, discuss our latest projects, join exclusive beta testing, and stay up-to-date with our studio right here: 

✨ https://discord.gg/fVgfeybS25 ✨

Second, we have some new content updates & additions for you! Notably, controller rumble, and a new puzzle in the last level!


 Fixed Z-layer of walls, and some lighting by the final door
 Prevented partner from sliding infinitely
 Pressing the "cancel" action (esc, button east, etc) in a UI submenu will back-track to primary menu
 Minimized reactivity of UI to external input (mouse movement or clicking anywhere on screen would activate button SFX/VFX)
 Modified default starting brightness from 10-20% to 40-50%
 Added controller rumble / haptic feedback to several events in game (eye states, obstacle death, door opening, scripted events, and 1 new secret event)
 Added a setting to turn off controller rumble
 Player no longer stutters at jump height peak
 Fixed walking animation on slopes - previously played jumping animation
 Final pressure plate lights don't turn off when the door opens
 Fixed parallax background occasionally skipping frames when going backwards
 Added randomized slow-blinking animations to the Blind Eyes in Level 6
 Fixed spike placement in Level 6 to account for moments when the eye timer is slightly off sequence due to an easter egg
 Replaced a puzzle in Level 6 with a new segment
 Improved camera follow to reduce snap-back
 Enhanced the resolution and optimization of most art assets, including tilemap
 Bird

Known Issues:

 Controllers do not function as intended with Steam Input enabled. Please disable Steam Input if you have issues (this means that switch pro controllers may misbehave without emulators)
 Controllers may not work in menu if connected during the beginning of the splash screen??? Please try reconnecting when the menu loads if this happens :(


Thank you for your support and patience! Please report any bugs you find. <3 We're excited to chat with you!

(\__/)

/ 　 づ . •　　 　 ⬦　　　 .　　 。 　 .

- BunBun Games

notes.title: Happy Anniversary!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! As of October 13th, it's been 1 year since we released our game. Thank you so much for all your support! Over the next several weeks, we'll be releasing some content changes, quality of life improvements, and bug fixes. 

We'll have a fun announcement coming for you soon too!

Here are the patch notes for October 20th:

 Slightly lowered force of gravity so player has gentler fall 
 Replaced all Tutorial UI with updated control icons
 Subtle pulse/shake animations were added to control icons to bring attention to tutorial instructions in game
 Added extra tutorial section to L1 based on Expo feedback (latch and extension tutorials were separated)
 Extended some platform trails 
 Slightly increased death screen shake, and improved death particles
 Some platforms that loop between 2 locations will now briefly pause at their destination 
 Some platforms in L3 will wait for the player to board before beginning its loop, to prevent players from having to wait too long for the platform to return after re-spawning
 Modified a platform in the first puzzle of L1 to prevent head-hitting
 Altered placement of pressure plates & surrounding tiles across all levels to reduce situations where players would be "pushed out of bounds" by releasing the box (testing a variety of potential code fixes to permanently fix problem, will push later on)
 Added a "controller recommended" screen to splash sequence. Slightly shortened timing of overall splash sequence
 Fixed strange sliding behavior on the player
 Disable reset && un-tether buttons when game is paused
 Updated credits


Stay tuned! There will be more to come. Thank you for your patience! Please report any bugs you find. <3 Special thanks to Chris Onorati for assisting with this update's launch after we encountered cryptic steam issues :')

(\__/)

notes.title: Happy Valentines Day! (New hidden achievement!)
notes.content:
You--uh... well, someone--asked for it! Try to find the new hidden valentines day achievement at the end of the game!

Here are some hints:
- It's at the final door
- It involves a certain statue
- It has some smoochin ;)


And as always, a few bugs were fixed:
- Replaced incorrect particle textures
- Balanced SFX volume
- Fixed a bug where restarting prevented a hidden achievement
- Fixed animation state machine occasionally breaking

More major bug fixes will occur during summer. Thank you for your patience! You can report additional bugs to bunbungames.studio@gmail.com

Sincerely,
BunBun Games (:3

notes.title: Patch 03 - Oct 14th
notes.content: Okay NOW the achievements actually work

notes.title: Patch 02 - Oct 14th
notes.content:
- Official achievements added to the game
- Added reverb to footsteps
- Modified assets for eyes for more readability
- Fixed bug where characters would slide if a box was placed between them
- Added UI SFX (page noise for buttons)
- Reduced friction on walls to make platforms easier to jump up to
- Volume priority adjustments for UI and Enemy audio 
- Fixed resolution aspect for 16:10
- Resolved several z-layering issues
- Updated cutscene timers & skipping
- When replaying game, checkpoints reset properly and player is detached from partner when they should be
- Munched several minor quality-of-life bugs

notes.title: Patch 01 - Oct 13th
notes.content:
- Fixed rendering issue in Level 6 where rope displayed over players & cutscenes
- Added fade-out back to menu from credits
- Addressed several layering issues and Z-fighting
- Removed infinite flying glitch
- Can no longer exit the last level without partner
